dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do many people come here to offer incense these days?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: This place is a little off the beaten track, and few people know that there is a temple here at all.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Hmm. Perhaps I should find some way to let people know this temple is here...
